open_items: 12.q.W supplies the safe source-byte binding only. 12.q.R expands hostile-source and hint boundaries; 12.q.C cleans the same behavior. Selection normalization/relocation (12.r), H3 states (12.s) and validation/diff/trace/view integration (12.t) remain future steps. No full-suite, external execution or release success is claimed.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Relation `implemented_by` MUSS `code_ref` als Zieltyp unterstützen.
oracle.scope: 12.q.W: The explicitly selected safe source yields owned raw bytes and exact file/Git binding without checkout, source execution, symbol resolution or language-specific tools. Raw file hash comparison is separate from H2/H3 currency evaluation. Existing records and selectors stay unchanged; failed reads produce no hash result. Native implemented_by accepts capability/requirement/decision to code_ref.

preconditions: 12.q.W: Owned validated code_ref RecordArtifact and an explicit native ProjectBoundary or GitObjectSource; original file/blob bytes and Git commit identities are supplied by the fixture, not inferred from source code.
steps: 12.q.W: Read the selected file or bound historical Git tree for each code reference kind; compare exact original bytes, size, SHA-256 and optional Git identities. Check immutable owned snapshots and unchanged worktree/index. Keep selectors and symbol hints passive. Reject mismatched bindings, missing paths and unsafe source boundaries. Resolve implemented_by targets through the native relation validator. Exercise the public read API in fresh Core/PYZ processes without third-party modules.
